vocabulary.meaning: 蓝领的；从事体力劳动的

subtitles.en: Good to be with you.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴和大家见面。

subtitles.en: I'm Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 我是托尼·多库皮尔。

subtitles.en: The breaking news right now.
subtitles.zh: 现在插播突发新闻。

subtitles.en: A monster storm.
subtitles.zh: 一场超级风暴。

subtitles.en: A dangerous category 3 hurricane set to slam the Gulf Coast with life-threatening storm surge and devastating winds.
subtitles.zh: 一场危险的三级飓风即将袭击墨西哥湾沿岸，带来威胁生命的风暴潮和破坏性大风。

subtitles.en: It's going to be a strong hurricane, and it's going to potentially do a lot of damage.
subtitles.zh: 这将是一场强飓风，可能会造成大量破坏。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: More than 130 million in the impact zone.
subtitles.zh: 受影响区域超过1.3亿人。

subtitles.en: The race to get out before landfall tonight.
subtitles.zh: 在今晚登陆前争分夺秒撤离。

subtitles.en: ICE out!
subtitles.zh: ICE滚出去！

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: ICE outrage.
subtitles.zh: ICE引发众怒。

subtitles.en: Protests after a federal immigration officer shot a man in a car with his five-year-old in the backseat.
subtitles.zh: 一名联邦移民官员在一辆车里开枪击中一名男子，当时他五岁的孩子就坐在后座，随后引发抗议。

subtitles.en: What authorities are saying tonight about why.
subtitles.zh: 当局今晚就开枪原因作出说明。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Panama rocked by a 7.7-magnitude earthquake.
subtitles.zh: 巴拿马发生7.7级地震。

subtitles.en: The moment playing out on live TV.
subtitles.zh: 直播画面记录下那一瞬间。

subtitles.en: MIKE TIRICO: The man forever linked with Chicago.
subtitles.zh: 这个永远与芝加哥联系在一起的人。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Honoring an NFL hero.
subtitles.zh: 致敬NFL英雄。

subtitles.en: Legendary Chicago Bears coach Mike Ditka dead at 86.
subtitles.zh: 传奇芝加哥熊队教练迈克·迪卡去世，享年86岁。

subtitles.en: POLICE OFFICER: I have him!
subtitles.zh: 我抓到他了！

subtitles.en: He's breathing!
subtitles.zh: 他还有呼吸！

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: A house on fire with a man trapped inside.
subtitles.zh: 一栋房屋起火，一名男子被困其中。

subtitles.en: The body-cam video as police rush in.
subtitles.zh: 警方冲入火场时的执法记录仪画面。

subtitles.en: Birds on a plane.
subtitles.zh: 飞机上的鸟。

subtitles.en: The passenger accused of smuggling batches of live birds stuffed in his underwear.
subtitles.zh: 这名乘客被控走私多批活鸟，塞在内裤里。

subtitles.en: And Steve Hartman goes on the road with a woman on a mission to reunite lost dogs with their humans.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼在路上采访一位致力于让走失狗狗与主人团聚的女性。

subtitles.en: You sweet boy.
subtitles.zh: 你这个乖宝贝。

subtitles.en: NARRATOR: From CBS News headquarters in New York, this is the CBS Evening News with Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 这里是纽约CBS新闻总部，我是托尼·多库皮尔，欢迎收看CBS晚间新闻。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: And good evening.
subtitles.zh: 晚上好。

subtitles.en: We begin tonight with that category 3 hurricane just hours from landfall along the Gulf Coast.
subtitles.zh: 今晚我们首先关注这场几小时后即将在墨西哥湾沿岸登陆的三级飓风。

subtitles.en: Pensacola Beach, Florida, as Hurricane Isaias approaches shore.
subtitles.zh: 飓风伊赛亚斯正逼近佛罗里达州彭萨科拉海滩。

subtitles.en: Maximum sustained winds near 115 miles an hour.
subtitles.zh: 最大持续风速接近每小时115英里。

subtitles.en: And the National Weather Service warning of life-threatening storm surge, possibly up to 9 feet in some spots, as the first hurricane of the Atlantic storm season closes in on Alabama and the Florida panhandle.
subtitles.zh: 美国国家气象局警告，这个巴西？大西洋飓风季的首个飓风正逼近阿拉巴马州和佛罗里达狭长地带，可能带来威胁生命的风暴潮，部分地区浪高可达9英尺。

subtitles.en: Our team is out there in the middle of all of it, starting with Jason Allen in Gulf Shores, Alabama.
subtitles.zh: 我们的团队正在现场，身处风暴中心，首先连线阿拉巴马州格尔夫肖尔斯的杰森·艾伦。

subtitles.en: Jason, good evening.
subtitles.zh: 杰森，晚上好。

subtitles.en: Tony, good evening, and the intensity of a storm this big is so evident in what we are seeing here in Gulf Shores where, on the backside, the wind is spinning and so strong, it's almost starting to calm some of these 10- and 11-foot waves.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，晚上好。这场风暴的强度在这里非常明显。在格尔夫肖尔斯，后侧的风旋转得非常猛烈，甚至开始把一些10到11英尺高的浪压平。

subtitles.en: And so people here now are preparing for power outages.
subtitles.zh: 所以这里的人们现在正在为停电做准备。

subtitles.en: They're preparing for flooding and, over the next several hours, much worse.
subtitles.zh: 他们也在为洪水做准备，接下来几个小时情况会更糟。

subtitles.en: Isaias is bearing down on the Gulf Coast, bringing with it dangerous surf, damaging winds, heavy rain, and early signs this powerful storm could leave behind significant damage.
subtitles.zh: 飓风伊赛亚斯正逼近墨西哥湾沿岸，带来危险巨浪、破坏性大风、暴雨，并且有早期迹象表明这场强风暴可能留下严重破坏。

subtitles.en: We're hoping to miss the worst of it, but we have to be prepared for the worst.
subtitles.zh: 我们希望躲过最坏的情况，但必须做好最坏的打算。

subtitles.en: JASON ALLEN: Orange Beach, Alabama, is taking a beating.
subtitles.zh: 阿拉巴马州橙滩正遭受重创。

subtitles.en: Officials closed the water because of potentially life-threatening rip currents.
subtitles.zh: 官方因可能危及生命的离岸流关闭了水域。

subtitles.en: This video, taken inside the center of the storm, shows wave heights of more than 30 feet.
subtitles.zh: 这段在风暴中心内部拍摄的视频显示浪高超过30英尺。

subtitles.en: During what was supposed to be a busy weekend for tourists, streets and beaches were empty.
subtitles.zh: 这本应是游客众多的繁忙周末，但街道和海滩却空无一人。

subtitles.en: Gone is the gridlock from the past 48 hours, and the evacuation window closed.
subtitles.zh: 过去48小时的交通拥堵已经消失，疏散窗口也已关闭。

subtitles.en: This is one of the bridges, one of the evacuation routes that takes people away from the coastline.
subtitles.zh: 这是其中一座桥，也是把人带离海岸线的疏散路线之一。

subtitles.en: And law enforcement tried to keep it open as long as they could, but by midday, the winds were too strong.
subtitles.zh: 执法部门尽可能长时间保持通行，但到中午时风力太大。

subtitles.en: There was no time left for people to evacuate.
subtitles.zh: 人们已经来不及撤离了。

subtitles.en: The few residents left are trying to make the best of it.
subtitles.zh: 少数留下来的居民只能尽量应对。

subtitles.en: Christi Woods manages one of the only businesses still open, a wine store.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯蒂·伍兹经营着少数仍在营业的店铺之一，一家葡萄酒商店。

subtitles.en: We do take precautions.
subtitles.zh: 我们确实做了防范。

subtitles.en: I mean, we're kind of in the flood zone.
subtitles.zh: 我是说，我们算是处在洪水区。

subtitles.en: There's not much you can do other than prepare the house best you can or leave.
subtitles.zh: 除了尽力把房子准备好，或者离开，真的没什么别的办法。

subtitles.en: Correct.
subtitles.zh: 没错。

subtitles.en: JASON ALLEN: In Pensacola, shops are boarded up, trying to save windows from flying debris.
subtitles.zh: 在彭萨科拉，商店用木板封住门窗，防止飞散碎片砸碎玻璃。

subtitles.en: A storm surge up to 9 feet, timed with a high tide, could flood areas well inland from the coastline.
subtitles.zh: 最高9英尺的风暴潮恰逢高潮，可能淹没远离海岸线的内陆深处地区。

subtitles.en: Florida's governor cautions about taking what's to come lightly.
subtitles.zh: 佛罗里达州州长提醒人们不要轻视即将到来的风暴。

subtitles.en: Folks who are in the path of this storm should know that this is not just going to be a random tropical system.
subtitles.zh: 位于风暴路径上的人们应该知道，这不会只是一个普通的热带天气系统。

subtitles.en: It's going to be a strong hurricane, and it's going to potentially do a lot of damage.
subtitles.zh: 这将是一场强飓风，可能会造成大量破坏。

subtitles.en: There are also potential impacts offshore.
subtitles.zh: 海上也可能受到影响。

subtitles.en: Oil workers evacuated platforms there.
subtitles.zh: 石油工人已从那里的平台撤离。

subtitles.en: There are refineries in the region.
subtitles.zh: 该地区还有炼油厂。

subtitles.en: Any potential impact to production or fuel prices is going to depend on just how much potential damage is done, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 对生产或燃油价格的潜在影响会有多大，要取决于实际损失可能有多严重，托尼。

subtitles.en: Jason, thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: 杰森，非常感谢。

subtitles.en: Let's get to meteorologist Rob Marciano.
subtitles.zh: 我们来看看气象学家罗布·马尔恰诺。

subtitles.en: He's in the Florida panhandle tracking the hurricane and another threat as well, a tropical storm slamming parts of the West Coast.
subtitles.zh: 他在佛罗里达狭长地带追踪这场飓风，以及另一个威胁——一场正在袭击西海岸部分地区的热带风暴。

subtitles.en: Rob, good evening to you.
subtitles.zh: 罗布，晚上好。

subtitles.en: Hey, good evening, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 嘿，晚上好，托尼。

subtitles.en: Well, needless to say, the time to prepare and evacuate is over because we're feeling the brunt of Hurricane Isaias right now.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，不用说，准备和撤离的时间已经结束了，因为我们现在正感受到飓风“伊萨亚斯”的正面冲击。

subtitles.en: It is front loaded, so the front 50 miles of this thing is where the most action is.
subtitles.zh: 这场飓风是前段最强，所以它前50英里的范围才是风雨最猛的地方。

subtitles.en: And, obviously, it's coming in right now.
subtitles.zh: 而且很明显，它现在正在逼近。

subtitles.en: The center of this is due south of us by about 50 miles and closing in at 17, 18 miles an hour.
subtitles.zh: 飓风中心在我们正南方约50英里处，正以每小时17、18英里的速度逼近。

subtitles.en: So it's just a matter of two, three, maybe four hours before it makes landfall.
subtitles.zh: 所以距离登陆只剩两三个、也许四个小时的事了。

subtitles.en: So what are the hazards in play with this?
subtitles.zh: 那么这次会带来哪些危险？

subtitles.en: Obviously, the wind, the rain.
subtitles.zh: 显然，是风和雨。

subtitles.en: On the right side of this, we've got a tornado watch that is up until at least 9 o'clock tonight, probably beyond that.
subtitles.zh: 在飓风右侧，我们有一个龙卷风警报，至少持续到今晚9点，可能还会更久。

subtitles.en: And then we're looking at 15 inches of rain, 9 feet of storm surge on not just the ocean side but on the bay side, too, and that's just loaded with all sorts of residents and businesses there.
subtitles.zh: 然后我们预计会有15英寸的降雨、9英尺的风暴潮，不仅是靠海一侧，海湾一侧也会有，而那里住着大量居民和企业。

subtitles.en: This thing comes ashore, it does weaken, but it brings a whole lot of rain with it all the way up the eastern half of the country.
subtitles.zh: 它登陆后会减弱，但会给整个东半部地区带来大量降雨。

subtitles.en: Now, in the West, we've got Rachel.
subtitles.zh: 现在看西部，我们有热带风暴“蕾切尔”。

subtitles.en: That's going to be coming into southern California.
subtitles.zh: 它将进入南加州。

subtitles.en: There's a tropical storm watch there for landfall tomorrow night.
subtitles.zh: 那里已发布热带风暴警报，预计明晚登陆。

subtitles.en: You've already felt those massive waves and that coastal flooding across between Los Angeles and San Diego, and that will only get worse before this thing makes landfall.
subtitles.zh: 你们已经感受到那些巨浪和洛杉矶到圣地亚哥之间的沿海洪水了，而在它登陆前，情况只会更糟。

subtitles.en: So, Tony, we are getting squeezed on both sides of the country by intense tropical cyclones.
subtitles.zh: 所以，托尼，我们国家两边都正受到强热带气旋的夹击。

subtitles.en: All right, Rob, stay safe.
subtitles.zh: 好的，罗布，注意安全。

subtitles.en: We'll keep watching it.
subtitles.zh: 我们会继续关注。

subtitles.en: Thank you.
subtitles.zh: 谢谢。

subtitles.en: In other news, a day after a federal immigration officer shot a man in New York City with his young son nearby, ICE is saying it was the man who, quote, "weaponized his vehicle," forcing the officer to open fire.
subtitles.zh: 其他新闻方面，一名联邦移民官员在纽约市开枪击中一名男子，当时他年幼的儿子就在附近。一天后，移民及海关执法局表示，是这名男子“把车辆当成武器”，迫使执法人员开枪。

subtitles.en: CBS Immigration Correspondent Camilo Montoya-Galvez reports.
subtitles.zh: CBS移民事务记者卡米洛·蒙托亚-加尔韦斯报道。

subtitles.en: CAMILO MONTOYA-GALVEZ: Surveillance video shows two ICE officers approaching Oscar Belgal's SUV before Belgal drives away.
subtitles.zh: 卡米洛·蒙托亚-加尔韦斯：监控录像显示，两名ICE执法人员走近奥斯卡·贝尔加尔的SUV，随后贝尔加尔开车离开。

subtitles.en: Nearby, people are seen ducking for cover.
subtitles.zh: 附近可以看到人们正急忙躲避。

subtitles.en: Today, the NYPD released body-camera footage showing officers driving up to the scene minutes after the shooting.
subtitles.zh: 今天，纽约市警察局公布了执法记录仪画面，显示枪击发生几分钟后警察驱车赶到现场。

subtitles.en: POLICE OFFICER: He's got a gun.
subtitles.zh: 警察：他有枪。

subtitles.en: CAMILO MONTOYA-GALVEZ: As the officers exit the car, a federal agent can be seen wearing a reflective vest and holding an assault-style weapon.
subtitles.zh: 卡米洛·蒙托亚-加尔韦斯：警察下车时，可以看到一名联邦探员身穿反光背心，手持攻击型武器。

subtitles.en: The driver, Oscar Belgal, is sitting on the ground in handcuffs, shot once in the neck by an ICE agent who, according to the NYPD, fired seven times into his car with Belgal's five-year-old child sitting in the back seat.
subtitles.zh: 司机奥斯卡·贝尔加尔戴着手铐坐在地上，脖子中了一枪。据纽约市警察局称，一名ICE探员向他的车连开七枪，当时贝尔加尔五岁的孩子就坐在后座。

subtitles.en: The officers then carried Belgal to a patrol car-- POLICE OFFICER: Put pressure.
subtitles.zh: 警察随后把贝尔加尔抬到巡逻车上——警察：按住伤口。

subtitles.en: CAMILO MONTOYA-GALVEZ: --and took him to a nearby hospital.
subtitles.zh: 卡米洛·蒙托亚-加尔韦斯：——然后把他送到附近医院。

subtitles.en: Authorities say his child was unharmed.
subtitles.zh: 当局说他的孩子没有受伤。

subtitles.en: DHS identified Belgal as a Dominican national living in the US illegally and with a criminal record, including a larceny conviction.
subtitles.zh: 国土安全部确认贝尔加尔是多米尼加公民，非法居住在美国，并有犯罪记录，包括一项盗窃罪定罪。

subtitles.en: Mr. Belgal was a target of an HSI investigation.
subtitles.zh: 贝尔加尔是国土安全调查局调查的目标。

subtitles.en: Mr. Belgal is associated with a gang.
subtitles.zh: 贝尔加尔与一个帮派有关联。

subtitles.en: CAMILO MONTOYA-GALVEZ: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin admitted agents did not know a child was in the car.
subtitles.zh: 卡米洛·蒙托亚-加尔韦斯：国土安全部长马克韦恩·马林承认，探员当时不知道车里有个孩子。

subtitles.en: Oscar knew he had a child in his car.
subtitles.zh: 奥斯卡知道自己的孩子就在车里。

subtitles.en: Oscar chose to accelerate at a high rate of speed and ram two different vehicles.
subtitles.zh: 奥斯卡却选择高速加速，并撞向两辆车。

subtitles.en: CAMILO MONTOYA-GALVEZ: New York City's mayor called for ICE to be abolished, a call echoed by scores of protesters.
subtitles.zh: 卡米洛·蒙托亚-加尔韦斯：纽约市长呼吁废除移民及海关执法局，大量抗议者也发出了同样的呼声。

subtitles.en: That's terrifying.
subtitles.zh: 这太可怕了。

subtitles.en: CAMILO MONTOYA-GALVEZ: Maribel Burgos lives in the neighborhood.
subtitles.zh: 卡米洛·蒙托亚-加尔韦斯：玛丽贝尔·布尔戈斯住在这个社区。

subtitles.en: And as a parent, I can't even-- sorry.
subtitles.zh: 作为一名家长，我甚至——抱歉。

subtitles.en: I can't even imagine gunshots happening so close to my kids.
subtitles.zh: 我甚至无法想象枪声会离我的孩子这么近。

subtitles.en: In a court hearing today, Tony, government lawyers at the Justice Department revealed that Belgal was actually transferred initially to New Jersey but has since been brought back here to New York City and is currently being held at the Metropolitan Detention Center in Brooklyn.
subtitles.zh: 在今天的法庭听证会上，托尼，司法部的政府律师透露，贝尔加尔起初被转移到新泽西州，但后来又被带回纽约市，目前被关押在布鲁克林的大都会拘留中心。

subtitles.en: His attorneys say that bullet that struck him here behind us is still inside of him.
subtitles.zh: 他的律师说，就在我们身后这里射中他的那颗子弹，现在还在他体内。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: Camilo, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 卡米洛，谢谢。

subtitles.en: We turn now to scenes from a massive earthquake today.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在来看今天一场大地震的画面。

subtitles.en: This is southern Panama, rocked by a 7.7-magnitude event, shaking buildings more than a hundred miles away and toppling others entirely, sparking a tsunami alert offshore.
subtitles.zh: 这是巴拿马南部，遭到一场7.7级地震袭击，一百多英里外的建筑都在摇晃，有些建筑完全倒塌，并触发了近海海啸警报。

subtitles.en: And the moment even played out on live TV as some broadcasters ran for cover.
subtitles.zh: 这一瞬间甚至在电视直播中上演，一些播音员急忙躲避。

subtitles.en: And the Pentagon's plans to not only execute the Fort Hood shooter but to livestream the event has even Republicans divided tonight.
subtitles.zh: 五角大楼计划不仅处决胡德堡枪手，还要直播行刑过程，今晚连共和党内部都因此出现分歧。

subtitles.en: Our Senior White House and Political Correspondent Ed O'Keefe has more.
subtitles.zh: 白宫及政治新闻资深记者埃德·奥基夫带来更多报道。

subtitles.en: ED O'KEEFE: President Trump today backed up Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's plan to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan.
subtitles.zh: 埃德·奥基夫：特朗普总统今天支持国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯直播处决尼达尔·哈桑的计划。

subtitles.en: Death penalty through firing squad, and he deserves it.
subtitles.zh: 用行刑队执行死刑，他罪有应得。

subtitles.en: Killed and wounded many, many people.
subtitles.zh: 他杀害和伤害了很多人。

subtitles.en: A maniac.
subtitles.zh: 一个疯子。

subtitles.en: ED O'KEEFE: But Vice President JD Vance says he's not interested in a live viewing.
subtitles.zh: 埃德·奥基夫：但副总统JD·万斯表示，他对观看直播不感兴趣。

subtitles.en: Look, if it's ultimately livestreamed, I'm not going to be watching it.
subtitles.zh: 听着，如果最终真的直播了，我是不会看的。

subtitles.en: ED O'KEEFE: Only Iran, Afghanistan, and Yemen have carried out known public executions in the last five years.
subtitles.zh: 过去五年里，只有伊朗、阿富汗和也门执行过已知的公开处决。

subtitles.en: Georgia Republican Congressman Austin Scott says, "This is what jihadists do.
subtitles.zh: 佐治亚州共和党众议员奥斯汀·斯科特说：“这是圣战分子才会干的事。

subtitles.en: America is better than that."
subtitles.zh: 美国应该比这更好。”

subtitles.en: The execution is scheduled for December 3 at 2:00 PM Eastern at Fort Hood, the same time 17 years ago Hasan opened fire, killing 13 people and wounding 32 more on the Texas base, a massacre he later said was carried out in support of the Taliban.
subtitles.zh: 处决定于东部时间12月3日下午2点在胡德堡执行。17年前的同一时间，哈桑在这座得克萨斯州的基地开枪，打死13人、打伤32人。他后来说，那场屠杀是为了支持塔利班。

subtitles.en: People need to understand that there are serious consequences for these types of things.
subtitles.zh: 人们需要明白，做这种事会有严重后果。

subtitles.en: ED O'KEEFE: This would be the first military execution by firing squad since World War II.
subtitles.zh: 这将是二战以来美军第一次用行刑队执行死刑。

subtitles.en: One option the Pentagon may consider is strapping Hasan, who's paralyzed from the waist down, to a specialized firing-squad chair with riflemen positioned a number of feet away.
subtitles.zh: 五角大楼可能考虑的一个方案，是用束带把腰部以下瘫痪的哈桑固定在专门的枪决椅上，步枪手站在几英尺之外。

subtitles.en: Louisiana Republican Senator John Kennedy.
subtitles.zh: 路易斯安那州共和党参议员约翰·肯尼迪。

subtitles.en: I wouldn't televise it or publicize it or whatever they're doing.
subtitles.zh: 我不会搞电视直播，也不会公开宣传，不管他们打算怎么做。

subtitles.en: I just think it makes our society coarser, and I wouldn't do it.
subtitles.zh: 我只是觉得那会让我们社会变得更粗俗，所以我不会这么做。

subtitles.en: ED O'KEEFE: The president today also announced Katie Zacharia will be the next White House press secretary.
subtitles.zh: 总统今天还宣布凯蒂·扎卡里亚将出任下一任白宫新闻秘书。

subtitles.en: She briefly served as Homeland Security spokeswoman and has been a frequent guest on conservative news channels.
subtitles.zh: 她曾短暂担任国土安全部发言人，也经常在保守派新闻频道做客。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: And, Ed, the president said he reached an agreement with Vladimir Putin to immediately import Russian diesel fuel.
subtitles.zh: 埃德，总统说他与弗拉基米尔·普京达成了立即进口俄罗斯柴油的协议。

subtitles.en: What can you tell us?
subtitles.zh: 你能给我们说说吗？

subtitles.en: Yeah, the president just last month signed a sweeping Russia sanctions law that was designed to restrict Russia's energy supply, but now he's relaxing sanctions on Russian diesel to try to bring down prices ahead of the midterms.
subtitles.zh: 是的，总统上个月刚签署了一项全面的对俄制裁法案，目的是限制俄罗斯能源供应，但现在他放松了对俄罗斯柴油的制裁，想在中期选举前压低价格。

subtitles.en: Putin has agreed to immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel.
subtitles.zh: 普京已同意立即供应30多万吨柴油。

subtitles.en: Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticized the deal, saying it only fuels Putin's war effort.
subtitles.zh: 乌克兰的弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基批评这项协议，说这只会助长普京的战争行动。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Ed, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 埃德，谢谢。

subtitles.en: It's a dangerous time to be a public official in the US, and we'll be learning more about that this Sunday as the director and deputy director of the Secret Service give their first joint interview to 60 Minutes.
subtitles.zh: 如今在美国当公职人员是件危险的事。本周日我们会了解更多情况：特勤局局长和副局长将首次共同接受《60分钟》采访。

subtitles.en: How would you describe the current threat environment in this country?
subtitles.zh: 你会如何描述这个国家当前面临的威胁环境？

subtitles.en: SEAN CURRAN: It's like we've never seen before.
subtitles.zh: 这是我们从未见过的。

subtitles.en: The threats on our full-time protectees are up just over 40% than they were last year.
subtitles.zh: 针对我们全职受保护人的威胁比去年增加了40%多一点。

subtitles.en: That's a massive increase.
subtitles.zh: 这是一个巨大的增幅。

subtitles.en: Norah O'Donnell joins us now with more from that conversation.
subtitles.zh: 诺拉·奥唐奈现在加入我们，带来更多采访内容。

subtitles.en: Norah, great to have you here.
subtitles.zh: 诺拉，很高兴你来了。

subtitles.en: So what more did they tell you about their ability to defend against those threats?
subtitles.zh: 关于他们防御这些威胁的能力，他们还说了些什么？

subtitles.en: There have been a lot of high-profile failures by the Secret Service in the past.
subtitles.zh: 特勤局过去有过许多备受瞩目的失败。

subtitles.en: That's why we wanted to talk to them directly, see the types of changes they're making.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们想直接和他们谈，看看他们正在做哪些改变。

subtitles.en: Number one, the Secret Service has been dangerously understaffed for years.
subtitles.zh: 首先，特勤局多年来一直人手严重不足。

subtitles.en: They had their largest recruitment class ever this year.
subtitles.zh: 今年他们招收了有史以来规模最大的一批新人。

subtitles.en: And on 60 Minutes, we're going to take you behind the scenes into the training facility to see not only how they're staffing up for this election but 2028.
subtitles.zh: 在《60分钟》里，我们会带你走进训练设施幕后，看看他们如何为这次选举乃至2028年增补人手。

subtitles.en: You've got a presidential election, all the candidates that they have to take care of.
subtitles.zh: 有一场总统选举，还有所有他们必须保护的候选人。

subtitles.en: You've got the Olympics in 2028.
subtitles.zh: 2028年还有奥运会。

subtitles.en: So there's a lot going on for the Service.
subtitles.zh: 所以特勤局有很多事情要应对。

subtitles.en: It's a big job, and the threats are real.
subtitles.zh: 任务很重，而且威胁是真实存在的。

subtitles.en: There are three known assassination attempts against President Trump, and I understand you learned more about that first one as the Secret Service learns more.
subtitles.zh: 针对特朗普总统有三次已知的暗杀未遂。据我所知，随着特勤局掌握更多信息，你们对第一次也有了更多了解。

subtitles.en: That was Butler, Pennsylvania, a gunman wounding the president's ear.
subtitles.zh: 那次发生在宾夕法尼亚州巴特勒，一名枪手打伤了总统的耳朵。

subtitles.en: Look, there were a series of failures that led to that day.
subtitles.zh: 听着，是一连串的失误导致了那天的事件。

subtitles.en: That has been reported by Congress.
subtitles.zh: 国会已经报告了这一点。

subtitles.en: A hundred missed calls between local police and the Secret Service.
subtitles.zh: 地方警方和特勤局之间错过了100通电话。

subtitles.en: So what do they have now?
subtitles.zh: 那他们现在有什么？

subtitles.en: A big truck that travels in the motorcade so that they can communicate.
subtitles.zh: 有一辆随车队行进的大卡车，用来保障通信。

subtitles.en: Thomas Crooks, the gunman who tried to kill President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, he was able to fly a drone for almost 10 minutes a couple hours before that assassination attempt.
subtitles.zh: 托马斯·克鲁克斯就是那个在宾夕法尼亚州巴特勒试图杀害特朗普总统的枪手，他在那次暗杀未遂前几小时，用无人机飞了将近10分钟。

subtitles.en: The Secret Service didn't detect it.
subtitles.zh: 特勤局没有发现。

subtitles.en: So now the Secret Service, one of their top jobs is looking at drones, not only surveillance but building offensive and defensive capabilities.
subtitles.zh: 所以现在特勤局的首要工作之一就是盯防无人机，不仅做监视，还要建设进攻和防御能力。

subtitles.en: You'll see that on Sunday on 60 Minutes.
subtitles.zh: 这周日你会在《60分钟》里看到这些。

subtitles.en: That's the world we live in.
subtitles.zh: 这就是我们所处的世界。

subtitles.en: So interesting and so important as well.
subtitles.zh: 既非常有趣，也非常重要。

subtitles.en: Norah, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 诺拉，谢谢。

subtitles.en: Thank you so much.
subtitles.zh: 非常感谢。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: And you can see much more of that interview this Sunday on 60 Minutes.
subtitles.zh: 本周日你可以在《60分钟》看到更多采访内容。

subtitles.en: Mike Ditka, the man and the myth.
subtitles.zh: 迈克·迪特卡，那个传奇人物。

subtitles.en: One of the most recognizable personalities in NFL history died today at 86.
subtitles.zh: NFL历史上最具辨识度的人物之一今天去世，享年86岁。

subtitles.en: He was a Hall of Fame player, a Super Bowl-winning coach, and a pitchman for just about everything.
subtitles.zh: 他是名人堂球员、超级碗冠军教练，还为几乎所有商品做过代言。

subtitles.en: Our Mark Strassmann remembers an icon.
subtitles.zh: 我们的马克·斯特拉斯曼来回顾这位标志性人物。

subtitles.en: Oh, shut up.
subtitles.zh: 哦，闭嘴。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: He was the real deal, a beloved tough guy.
subtitles.zh: 他是货真价实的人，一个受人喜爱的硬汉。

subtitles.en: See that?
subtitles.zh: 看到没？

subtitles.en: That's your IQ, buddy, zero.
subtitles.zh: 哥们儿，那是你的智商，零。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: All morning, Chicagoans reached out to grieve.
subtitles.zh: 整个早上，芝加哥人纷纷前来悼念。

subtitles.en: Did you hear?
subtitles.zh: 你听说了吗？

subtitles.en: Ditka.
subtitles.zh: 迪特卡。

subtitles.en: He is considered a Bears sports legend and a Chicago sports legend.
subtitles.zh: 他被认为是熊队的体育传奇，也是芝加哥的体育传奇。

subtitles.en: ANNOUNCER: Ditka smacks into a host of dark jerseys and simply bulls his way through a maze of tacklers.
subtitles.zh: 迪特卡撞上一群穿深色球衣的队员，硬是从一堆擒抱手中间挤了过去。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: As number 89, a Hall of Fame player; as a Super Bowl-winning coach; as a personality, Mike Ditka was all Bear.
subtitles.zh: 作为89号，他是名人堂球员；作为超级碗冠军教练；作为一个极具个性的人，迈克·迪特卡完完全全是熊队的人。

subtitles.en: REPORTER: Mike, why are you in such a bad mood?
subtitles.zh: 迈克，你为什么心情这么差？

subtitles.en: What do you care?
subtitles.zh: 关你什么事。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: Iron Mike was forged in a tough mill town, Aliquippa, Pennsylvania.
subtitles.zh: 铁血迈克是在宾夕法尼亚州阿勒奎帕一个艰苦的钢铁小镇里磨炼出来的。

subtitles.en: Football got him out, but its fiery, proudly blue-collar spirit never left him.
subtitles.zh: 橄榄球让他走出了那里，但他身上那种火爆、自豪的蓝领精神从未离开。

subtitles.en: MIKE DITKA: We like our people.
subtitles.zh: 我们喜欢我们的人。

subtitles.en: For those who don't like our people, that's tough [BLEEP].
subtitles.zh: 那些不喜欢我们的人，那可真够受的（消音）。

subtitles.en: We like them.
subtitles.zh: 我们喜欢他们。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: On SNL, the coach of-- Da Bears!
subtitles.zh: 在《周六夜现场》上，这位教练——熊队！

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: --became comic gold.
subtitles.zh: ——成了喜剧经典。

subtitles.en: Ditka believed everyone has a destiny, and Chicago was his.
subtitles.zh: 迪特卡相信每个人都有命运，而芝加哥就是他的归宿。

subtitles.en: Thank you.
subtitles.zh: 谢谢你们。

subtitles.en: And go Bears!
subtitles.zh: 熊队加油！

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: Number 89 was 86.
subtitles.zh: 89号享年86岁。

subtitles.en: Mark Strassmann, CBS News.
subtitles.zh: 马克·斯特拉斯曼，CBS新闻。

subtitles.en: Still ahead on the broadcast tonight, with no time to spare and firefighters yet to arrive, what police officers did to reach a man trapped in a house fire.
subtitles.zh: 今晚节目稍后：消防员尚未赶到、时间紧迫，警察如何救出被困火场的男子。

subtitles.en: We're back with a story of bravery in the face of a house fire, but this time, it was the cops who ran in after arriving first and learning someone could be trapped inside.
subtitles.zh: 我们回来继续讲一个面对房屋火灾的勇敢故事，不过这次是警察先到，得知可能有人被困后冲了进去。

subtitles.en: Here's our Kris Van Cleave.
subtitles.zh: 下面是我们的记者克里斯·范克莱夫。

subtitles.en: KRIS VAN CLEAVE: Rushing towards danger.
subtitles.zh: 冲向危险。

subtitles.en: Dramatic new body-camera video captures the heroic efforts of Culpeper, Virginia, police responding to a house fire last Saturday with a person possibly inside.
subtitles.zh: 新的执法记录仪视频拍下了弗吉尼亚州卡尔佩珀警方上周六在一场房屋火灾中英勇救人的画面，当时屋内可能有人。

subtitles.en: Officers raced into the house and up the stairs towards the smoke.
subtitles.zh: 警员们冲进房子，跑上楼梯，朝浓烟方向冲去。

subtitles.en: POLICE OFFICER 1: Police department!
subtitles.zh: 我们是警察！

subtitles.en: If you're in here-- KRIS VAN CLEAVE: Finding a locked bedroom door, one officer used a pocket tool to quickly pick the lock.
subtitles.zh: 如果你在里面——此时他们发现一间卧室门锁着，一名警察用随身小工具快速打开了锁。

subtitles.en: POLICE OFFICER 2: Somebody's inside.
subtitles.zh: 里面有人。

subtitles.en: POLICE OFFICER 1: OK.
subtitles.zh: 好。

subtitles.en: Yep.
subtitles.zh: 对。

subtitles.en: KRIS VAN CLEAVE: Then one of the officers crawled under the thick black smoke, finding a man unresponsive on his bed.
subtitles.zh: 然后其中一名警察在浓黑的烟雾下爬行，发现一名男子躺在床上，已经没有反应。

subtitles.en: POLICE OFFICER 1: I have him!
subtitles.zh: 我抓到他了！

subtitles.en: He's breathing!
subtitles.zh: 他还有呼吸！

subtitles.en: KRIS VAN CLEAVE: The officers pulled the man out of the smoke, away from the fire, and to safety.
subtitles.zh: 警察把这名男子从浓烟中拉出来，远离火场，带到了安全地带。

subtitles.en: POLICE OFFICER 2: Hey, we need help!
subtitles.zh: 嘿，我们需要帮忙！

subtitles.en: KRIS VAN CLEAVE: Police say the resident was taken to an area hospital before being transferred to a burn unit.
subtitles.zh: 警方表示，这名住户先被送往当地医院，后来转到了烧伤科。

subtitles.en: Three officers were treated for smoke inhalation and released.
subtitles.zh: 三名警察因吸入烟雾接受了治疗，现已出院。

subtitles.en: Kris Van Cleave, CBS News, Washington.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯·范克莱夫，CBS新闻，华盛顿报道。

subtitles.en: Still ahead, the deep-sea discovery that reminded researchers of SpongeBob SquarePants.
subtitles.zh: 稍后还有：深海的发现让研究人员想起了海绵宝宝。

subtitles.en: What they found.
subtitles.zh: 他们发现了什么。

subtitles.en: A man arrested at the airport in Miami this week had an unexplained bulge, according to federal investigators, and here's what they say it was, 10 birds stuffed into tubes and hidden in his underpants.
subtitles.zh: 据联邦调查人员称，本周在迈阿密机场被捕的一名男子身上有个不明原因的鼓包，他们说那是10只鸟被塞进管子里，藏在内裤里。

subtitles.en: The birds are OK, I'm happy to learn, but the man faces smuggling charges.
subtitles.zh: 我很高兴得知这些鸟都没事，但这名男子面临走私指控。

subtitles.en: Exotic birds apparently can sell for thousands or more.
subtitles.zh: 珍稀鸟类显然能卖到几千美元甚至更多。

subtitles.en: News for SpongeBob fans.
subtitles.zh: 海绵宝宝粉丝有好消息。

subtitles.en: His cartoon buddy, Patrick Star, was spotted near Argentina.
subtitles.zh: 他的卡通伙伴派大星在阿根廷附近被发现了。

subtitles.en: Not really him, of course, but researchers have noted the similarity and celebrated the sighting amid 57 new species recently filmed and photographed by a deep-sea rover.
subtitles.zh: 当然不是真的它，但研究人员注意到了相似之处，并为深海探测器最近拍摄到的57个新物种中的这一发现感到兴奋。

subtitles.en: All never before seen in a SpongeBob episode or anywhere else.
subtitles.zh: 所有这些在《海绵宝宝》剧集或其他任何地方都从未见过。

subtitles.en: And it could have been the end for a man in a sinking car near Syracuse, New York, but a state trooper responding to the call ran down a dock next to the boat launch and used a window punch to shatter the car's sunroof.
subtitles.zh: 纽约州雪城附近，一名男子连人带车沉入水中，本来可能没命；但接到报警的州警跑到船坡旁边的码头，用破窗器砸碎了汽车天窗。

subtitles.en: The driver got out with only minor cuts.
subtitles.zh: 司机只受了几处轻微划伤就出来了。

subtitles.en: No word on how the car ended up in the lake in the first place.
subtitles.zh: 目前还不清楚这辆车最初是怎么掉进湖里的。

subtitles.en: Up next, Steve Hartman takes us on the road to meet a woman reuniting missing dogs with their humans.
subtitles.zh: 接下来，史蒂夫·哈特曼带我们上路，去见一位帮助走失狗狗与主人团聚的女士。

subtitles.en: It's Friday, which means it's time to go on the road, where Steve Hartman has a story of dogs lost and dogs found.
subtitles.zh: 今天是周五，意味着又到了“在路上”的环节，史蒂夫·哈特曼带来一个关于狗狗走失又找回的故事。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: Christine Quaiff is a hunter of sorts, often going deep into the woods around Richmond, Virginia, to track and trap family members.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯汀·奎夫算是个猎人，经常深入弗吉尼亚州里士满周围的树林里，去追踪并诱捕“家人”。

subtitles.en: When someone loses their dog, that's their child.
subtitles.zh: 对有些人来说，丢了狗就像丢了孩子。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: And that's why, over the last few years, Christine has captured dozens of lost dogs.
subtitles.zh: 正因为如此，过去几年里，克里斯汀已经找回了数十只走失的狗。

subtitles.en: She's part of a growing national network of lost-pet-recovery specialists who offer this service, often for free.
subtitles.zh: 她是一个日益壮大的全国性寻宠专家网络的一员，他们经常免费提供这项服务。

subtitles.en: It's about being kind to other people and doing what you wish people would do for you.
subtitles.zh: 这就是善待他人，你希望别人怎么对你，就怎么对别人。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: Her most recent case was a desperate search for two Goldendoodles, Bailee and Toby.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：她最近接的一起案子，是紧急寻找两只金贵犬——贝利和托比。

subtitles.en: They belonged to 66-year-old Annie Olup.
subtitles.zh: 它们的主人是66岁的安妮·奥卢普。

subtitles.en: Annie lost her husband a couple years ago, and caring for those dogs had become her purpose, until a few weeks ago when she got in a bad car accident.
subtitles.zh: 安妮几年前失去了丈夫，照顾那两只狗就成了她的生活重心，直到几周前她遭遇了一场严重车祸。

subtitles.en: I thought, I'm going to go back to this house, and it's just going to feel so empty.
subtitles.zh: 我当时想，等我回到这个家，肯定会觉得空落落的。

subtitles.en: Annie was driving in a heavy rain when she hit a guardrail, flipped her car, and almost died.
subtitles.zh: 安妮当时冒着大雨开车，结果撞上护栏，车翻了，人差点没命。

subtitles.en: Her dogs were also in the car.
subtitles.zh: 她的狗当时也在车里。

subtitles.en: They survived, but they were missing.
subtitles.zh: 它们活了下来，但不见了。

subtitles.en: Yeah, dogs typically are going to just run away as quick as possible from the commotion and look for quietness.
subtitles.zh: 是啊，狗一般会尽快从那片混乱中跑开，去找个安静的地方。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: Christine used drones and trail cameras to narrow the search, then set traps, changed the food twice a day, and agreed to stay on the case indefinitely.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：克里斯汀用无人机和野外相机缩小搜索范围，然后设下诱捕笼，每天换两次食物，还答应无限期地跟下去。

subtitles.en: And all of this in addition to her day job in software development.
subtitles.zh: 而这一切都是在她软件开发的本职工作之外做的。

subtitles.en: So you're constantly checking cameras.
subtitles.zh: 所以你要不停查看相机。

subtitles.en: You're sleeping in your car.
subtitles.zh: 你还要睡在车里。

subtitles.en: Yes.
subtitles.zh: 是的。

subtitles.en: This is bordering on obsession.
subtitles.zh: 这已经有点接近痴迷了。

subtitles.en: Absolutely.
subtitles.zh: 绝对是。

subtitles.en: Again, the joy of seeing them be reunited is ultimately what makes us keep going.
subtitles.zh: 再说，看到它们重新团聚的那种喜悦，才是让我们一直坚持下去的动力。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: In the end, it took 10 days to catch Toby, 16 days to catch Bailee-- Put your glasses on.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：最后，抓托比花了10天，抓贝利花了16天——把眼镜戴上。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: --and no time at all for the tears to flow once Annie saw her babies were back.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：——而安妮一看到她的宝贝们回来了，眼泪一下子就流了下来。

subtitles.en: ANNIE Olup: Oh my gosh, my precious!
subtitles.zh: 安妮·奥卢普：天哪，我的宝贝！

subtitles.en: Yes.
subtitles.zh: 是的。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: The three are now home together, thanks to that stranger who believes it takes a village to raise a child, even the furry ones.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：现在这三个已经一起回到家，这都要感谢那位陌生人，她相信养育一个孩子需要全村人的力量，哪怕是毛孩子。

subtitles.en: Steve Hartman on the road in Richmond, Virginia.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼，弗吉尼亚州里士满报道。

subtitles.en: You sweet boy.
subtitles.zh: 你真是个好孩子。

subtitles.en: Thank you, Steve.
subtitles.zh: 谢谢你，史蒂夫。

subtitles.en: That's another day in America and another week.
subtitles.zh: 这就是美国的又一天，也是又一周的结束。

subtitles.en: I'm Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 我是托尼·多库皮尔。

subtitles.en: For all of us here at CBS News, thank you for watching this week.
subtitles.zh: 我们CBS新闻的全体同仁，感谢您收看本周节目。

subtitles.en: We'll see you right back here on Monday.
subtitles.zh: 我们下周一再见。

subtitles.en: Good night.
subtitles.zh: 晚安。
